snippet.description:
Before she was incarcerated, former Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes approached A24 about creating a documentary about her life. Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim were given access to her life ahead of her jail time and created a film that had a shocking $15 million debut weekend at the box office last weekend. But despite its monetary success, did You Can See Everything give Holmes what she wanted? And exactly what is that, anyway?
